subject.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried's fraud conviction was vacated on appeal in June 2026.

summary: Verdict: FALSE. As of 2026-10-01, Sam Bankman-Fried's fraud conviction has not been vacated; the Second Circuit upheld it on June 12, 2026, and he is seeking Supreme Court review.

findings.statement: Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted of fraud by a jury in November 2023.
Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in federal prison on March 28, 2024.
On June 12, 2026, the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit upheld Sam Bankman-Fried's fraud conviction and refused to vacate it.

conflict_notes: The undated image sbf_appeal.png claims the Second Circuit vacated Sam Bankman-Fried's fraud conviction in June 2026, but multiple dated, reputable sources (law.com, politico.com, nbcnews.com, washingtonpost.com, courtlistener.com) from June 12, 2026 state the court upheld the conviction and refused to vacate it; the latter were given greater weight due to their recency, specificity, and independent corroboration.
